items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: We had the Basie band and George Shearing played, uninvited, in fact he couldn’t stop, he was enjoying himself.

ctx.x: And I still say that the 70th birthday party that you put on for him in Las Vegas was the greatest party I’ve ever been to. It was absolutely fabulous.
I thought that was fun I must say. We had the Basie band and George Shearing played, uninvited, in fact he couldn’t stop, he was enjoying himself.
He started to play the introduction to “Every Day,” and said, “Joe, get up here and sing” in the Basie band.
